name: Mercenary Lightning Bolt
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Lightning Bolt (players/warlock/mercenary/lightning_bolt_merc.sval, 12 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 6 (in brackets): mana 45 (55). Its own mana 45 (55), cooldown 0.5 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Lightning Bolt as at level 6 (10 targets, 35 magical each) for 45 mana.
